EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7
My No.: WGSWD&EIP/ACQ/KB/12. Land Ministry’s Ref. No.: 4/3/10/2012/LRB/97.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the land described below to create a water reserve and water tank to store water temporarily in the paddy field in Boralesgamuwa under Weras Ganga Strom Water Drainage and Environment Improvement project.

Description of the Land to be acquired: Twenty (20) allotments of land in total extent of 16.8610 hectare depicted as Lot No. 01 to 20 in the Preliminary Plan No. 9466 dated 07.12.2015 prepared by the Survey General situated in the village called Boralesgamuwa in the Grama Niladhari Divisions No. 533 B of Boralesgamuwa west A and 535 A of Bellanwila in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kesbewa in Colombo District of Western Province and more fully described as follows.
1. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Could not be traced; Description: Marshy Land; Claimant:State; Original Claimant:
Mr. Susantha Kalansooriya, No. 30 A, Pitawella Road, Boralesgamuwa, Mr. D. I. A. Mathurata, No. 08, Dehiwala Road, Boralesgamuwa; Extent: 16.1520 Hectares.
2. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: Could not be traced; Description: Road; Claimant: State; Original Claimant: Could not be traced; Extent: 0.1218 Hectare.

C. W. ABEYSURIYA, Acquiring Officer, Weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage & Environment Improvement Project, Divisional Secretary’s Division, Kesbewa.
